policy: Decision 1 of the audit: corrected values are SHOWN, never silently substituted. Nothing in this suite writes to a delivered file, a mask, a record or a sidecar; every FAIL below is a statement about a file that is still on disk exactly as the pipeline team issued it.

Decision 2: the rater page carries no accuracy score. Every agreement figure in this report is marked audience=internal-evaluation. The semi-oracle disclosure is method rather than score and does belong on the rater page; it is quoted in the header for that use.
A FAIL is a finding. A FAIL that carries a `known` field was already written down by the 2026-09-29 audit and is quoted there; a FAIL with no `known` field is new.
semi_oracle_disclosure: Every displayed mask is semi-oracle: SAM 3 was given a bounding box computed from the ground-truth contour of that structure on that slice (pad 3 px) and was run only on slices where the reference covers at least 50 px at 256x256, so there are zero predicted voxels on any reference-absent slice. The agreement figures in this report are interactive ceilings, not deployment numbers.

KiTS23 annotates ONE kidney class, so right and left are computed on both sides of this comparison and the per-side entries are only as sound as the two rules agreeing. The reference split here (nearest-centroid to the two principal kidney masses (no component discarded), 256074 right / 229104 left) keeps every kidney voxel. It reproduces the arm builder's own reference split exactly, so any per-side disagreement is on the PREDICTION side. The builder's own note on the prediction: 1 component(s) larger than 5000 voxels (78,604 voxels in total) sit near enough to the midline that nearest-centroid and nearest-surface put them on OPPOSITE sides; the side shown is the nearest-centroid one and is not established anatomy. Concretely, a 78604-voxel component is put on side 13 by nearest-centroid while nearest-surface puts it on side 2 (19.3 mm to the right mass against 35.1 mm to the left), which is enough on its own to move the per-side Dice by tenths. kidney_pooled is therefore the sound kidney comparison, and it is the one the clinician's question about the tissue around the kidney is about.
